title: Judgment of 26 February 2007 — Application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide (Bosnia and Herzegovina v. Serbia and Montenegro)
holding_summary: The Court affirmed jurisdiction on the basis of Article IX of the Genocide Convention.
The Court found that Serbia had not committed genocide through organs or persons whose acts engaged its responsibility.
The Court found that Serbia violated its obligation under the Genocide Convention to prevent genocide in Srebrenica.
The Court found a breach connected with failure fully to cooperate with the ICTY.
